info.title: goldberries.net
info.summary: This is the API documentation for goldberries.net

get.summary: Run an administrative action
get.description: Runs one of the registered administrative actions. All actions require a logged-in player account. `reject_challenge` and `swap_lobbies` require Helper or higher, `merge_players` requires Verifier or higher, and `clean_campaign_data_errors` requires Admin.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Action to run

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Challenge ID for `reject_challenge`

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Rejection reason for `reject_challenge`

parameters.name: campaign_id
parameters.description: Campaign ID for `swap_lobbies`

parameters.name: sort_a
parameters.description: First lobby index for `swap_lobbies`

parameters.name: sort_b
parameters.description: Second lobby index for `swap_lobbies`

parameters.name: base_player_id
parameters.description: Player ID to retain for `merge_players`

parameters.name: merge_player_id
parameters.description: Player ID to delete for `merge_players`

400.description: Missing, invalid, or incompatible action parameters

403.description: Account does not have the required role

404.description: Referenced challenge, campaign, or player was not found

500.description: The administrative action failed while updating data

get.summary: Process campaign GameBanana data
get.description: Downloads and processes the GameBanana files for one or more database campaigns. Multiple campaign IDs may be supplied as a comma-separated value. Requires Helper or higher.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: One or more comma-separated database campaign IDs

parameters.name: regenerate
parameters.description: Whether to force re-download of cached GameBanana files

200.description: One processing result per supplied campaign ID

403.description: Account does not have Helper or higher permissions

get.summary: Process a GameBanana campaign preview
get.description: Downloads and processes a GameBanana mod or WIP without requiring an existing database campaign. Requires a logged-in player account. The `regenerate` option requires Helper or higher.

parameters.name: gamebanana_url
parameters.description: Full GameBanana mod or WIP URL

parameters.name: regenerate
parameters.description: Whether to force re-download and reprocessing of cached files

403.description: Account does not have permission to regenerate data

503.description: All campaign processing slots are currently in use

get.summary: Retrieve processed temporary campaign data
get.description: Returns the cached `index.json` generated for a GameBanana mod or WIP. Requires a logged-in player account.

parameters.name: gamebanana_url
parameters.description: Full GameBanana mod or WIP URL

404.description: Temporary campaign data was not found

500.description: Temporary campaign data could not be read

get.summary: Retrieve processed temporary map data
get.description: Returns the cached JSON for one bin path from a processed GameBanana mod or WIP. With `check_exists=true`, returns only an existence flag. Requires a logged-in player account.

parameters.name: gamebanana_url
parameters.description: Full GameBanana mod or WIP URL

parameters.name: bin_path
parameters.description: Relative path of the bin file within the GameBanana campaign

parameters.name: check_exists
parameters.description: Return only whether the processed map data exists

200.description: Existence flag or processed map JSON

oneOf.description: The structure of processed map JSON depends on the bin data.

400.description: Missing or invalid GameBanana URL or bin path

404.description: Temporary map data was not found

500.description: Temporary map data could not be read

post.summary: Upload an image or icon asset
post.description: Uploads a PNG, JPEG, GIF, or WebP file to an approved asset directory. Requires a logged-in player account and News Writer access. The `map_image` destination requires a numeric `map_id`; map images are resized to 1920x1080 and saved as WebP.

file.description: PNG, JPEG, GIF, or WebP file

file_name.description: Optional file name without extension; defaults to the uploaded file name. Ignored for `map_image`.

400.description: Missing or invalid upload parameters, file extension, image, or dimensions

403.description: Account or destination role is not authorized

404.description: Map specified by `map_id` was not found

500.description: Upload or destination processing failed

get.summary: Retrieve the current account API key
get.description: Returns the authenticated account's API key. The optional account ID is not used by this operation; it always returns the current account's key.

post.description: Generates and stores a new API key for the current account. A Verifier or higher may provide `id` to regenerate the key for another account.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Optional target account ID; requires Verifier or higher

403.description: Account is suspended or lacks the required role

500.description: Failed to update the API key

delete.description: Removes the current account's API key. A Verifier or higher may provide `id` to revoke the key for another account.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Optional target account ID; requires Verifier or higher

403.description: Account is suspended or lacks the required role

500.description: Failed to revoke the API key

get.summary: Retrieve a submission or list of submissions

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A submission ID, an array of submission IDs, or `all`.

200.description: A submission or list of submissions with related objects expanded.

404.description: A requested submission does not exist.

post.description: Creates a submission when `id` is omitted and updates an existing submission when `id` is provided. Players may update their own permitted fields; Helpers may perform verification and broader edits. `challenge_id` or `new_challenge` is required when creating a submission.

requestBody.description: Submission data. The optional `skip_webhook` and `like_challenge` flags control side effects; `new_challenge` may be supplied instead of `challenge_id` when creating a submission.

400.description: Invalid submission data, challenge, difficulty, date, or URL.

403.description: The account cannot submit for or edit the requested player, or Helper access is required.

500.description: The submission could not be saved.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the submission to delete.

500.description: The submission could not be deleted.

post.description: Verifies or rejects all listed pending submissions after validating the complete batch. Requires Helper access.

500.description: A submission could not be updated.

parameters.description: Optional lifecycle filter. `true` includes completed or rejected suggestions, `false` includes active undecided suggestions, and omission selects expired but undecided suggestions.

parameters.description: Number of records to return, clamped to the range 1 through 100.

200.description: Random records of the requested type.

post.description: Creates a notice for a pending submission. Requires Helper access; the authenticated helper is stored as the verifier.

400.description: The submission is missing, does not exist, or has already been verified.

delete.description: Deletes a verification notice. Requires Helper access.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The verification notice ID to delete.

200.description: The verification notice was deleted successfully.

500.description: The verification notice could not be deleted.
